input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of consequential/indirect damages (p0027), carved out for indemnification and confidentiality. A document-wide search for "aggregate", "exceed" and liability language returns no monetary cap anywhere, including in the warranty (Section 9) and indemnity (Sections 10-11) provisions. Both parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct liability, which fails the rule's requirement of a mutual cap at a meaningful amount. A fees-based cap alone would be illusory here because Section 5 is a revenue share under which Customer pays Kubient no fees, so the redline uses amounts paid or payable between the Parties with a USD 1,000,000 floor, and places confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap.

ops.text: (b) Except with respect to Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable between the Parties under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights; and amounts owed by a Party under Section 5 shall not be treated as damages subject to this Section 7(b).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] This Agreement excludes consequential damages but contains no monetary cap, so both Parties are exposed without limit. We have added a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' amounts paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 (a fee-only basis would be illusory under the revenue-share model in Section 5), with indemnification, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap. We can accept a mutual cap of twelve months' amounts with carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of 12 months' amounts and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 7.
